annotations.title: Ways to meet new people in an Israeli city

description: Returns what Bamboo Connect has published about meeting new people in an Israeli city or for a given audience: the local networking and community scene (which kinds of groups exist, where people meet), how to start, and links to the full pages. Use when someone asks how to make friends, meet new people, find a community or do networking in a city in Israel, or how a specific group (founders, new immigrants, people in their 30s, new parents and others) can meet people in person. Content is in Hebrew and comes from public pages; it never includes members or personal data.

audience.description: Who is looking, optional: founders = יזמים; freelancers = פרילנסרים; new-in-city = חדשים בעיר; tech = אנשי הייטק; runners = שותפים לריצה; designers = מעצבים; thirties = אנשים בשלב החיים שלכם; twenties = בני 20+; forties = בני 40+; fifties-plus = בני 50+; sixties-plus = בני 60+; single-again = אנשים אחרי פרק א׳; new-parents = הורים טריים; remote-workers = עובדים מרחוק; olim = עולים חדשים; dog-owners = בעלי כלבים; board-games = חובבי משחקי קופסה; book-club = מועדון קריאה; students = סטודנטים.

city.description: A city in Israel, in Hebrew or English, e.g. "תל אביב", "Haifa", "כפר סבא". Optional.
